style_standard.route: Route A: High-detail distorted pure-box EntityModel (native Minecraft 26.2, zero external animation libraries)
style_standard.texture_style: High-res grimy realistic (aligned with 128px Level 0 wallpaper & carpet)
style_standard.units: 16 MC model pixels = 1.0 block/meter; Y-down with ground at y=24.0; entity faces -Z
style_standard.doorway_clearance_note: Fits smoothly through Level 0 narrowest 2x3 doorways (including Red Room 2-wide doorways).

texture_atlas.note: Each box uses CubeListBuilder.texOffs(u, v) pointing into its material's 152x152 atlas region. Since max box UV footprint is < 36x24px, all boxes fit cleanly inside their assigned region with zero bleeding.

coordinate_conversion.rotation_order: Minecraft ModelPart default (XYZ Euler: apply X, then Y, then Z via xRot/yRot/zRot in radians)
coordinate_conversion.note: Note on Blender naming: Arm_L/Leg_L sit at negative X (viewer's left = entity's anatomical right), Arm_R/Leg_R sit at positive X (entity's anatomical left). Coordinates and rotations in this file are already converted and self-consistent—do not mirror X.
